# LNK test fixtures

`eicar.lnk` is a synthetic EICAR-in-a-shortcut. The `real-malware-*.lnk` files
are real in-the-wild malicious shortcuts (Unicode, TargetIDList + LinkInfo),
renamed from their sha256 for readability.
